cortex_queries.question: Show me claimants appearing across more than one carrier.
cortex_queries.sql:
SELECT canonical_entity_id, given_name, family_name, COUNT(DISTINCT carrier) AS carrier_count
FROM resolved_entities re
JOIN entity_sources es ON es.canonical_entity_id = re.canonical_entity_id
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT carrier) > 1
ORDER BY carrier_count DESC;

cortex_queries.question: How many resolutions were escalated for human review this run?
cortex_queries.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS escalated
FROM resolution_runs

  AND flagged_for_review = TRUE;

cortex_queries.question: What is the average match confidence, broken down by outcome?
cortex_queries.sql:
SELECT case_type,
       ROUND(AVG(confidence), 2) AS avg_confidence,
       COUNT(*) AS cases
FROM resolution_cases
WHERE run_id = 'run_2026-06-18T14:22:07Z_8f3c1a'
GROUP BY case_type
ORDER BY avg_confidence DESC;
